evidence: Titanium oxide thin film is attractive for fundamental research as well as for application in electronics and optics, It stimulates many investigations in this field. In this paper very thin films of titanium oxide were grown by the molecular layering technique (ML) (atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) [5)) on the (0001) surface of sapphire and were investigated by ellipsometry, angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and atomic force microscopy. ... The thickness of titanium oxide films was estimated with ellipsometry. ... The mode of titanium oxide film growth on (0001) a-Al2O3 surface was identified by means of angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy investigation.
